published.source: Scorpid Sting duty preset (standards 23), 2026-10-15: 180 s, 20000 iterations, seed 1

verify.note: same sim as the published number

summary: Marksmanship 5/41/5 with Lone Wolf (+20% damage with no pet out), played with the pet dismissed. It is the hunter's default and best Level 60 build, 44 DPS ahead of Marksmanship with a cat because a Forever pet takes no player buffs.
rotation: Pre-pull: Aspect of the Hawk at -3 s, Rapid Fire at -0.1 s
Rapid Fire, racials, potions and Demonic Rune on cooldown
Arcane Shot on cooldown (above Aimed Shot, no mana floor)
Aimed Shot on the cooldown it shares with Multi-Shot
Scorpid Sting (2% off the boss's hit, 9% of base mana) at the pull and again in its last 2 s, in place of Serpent Sting; the raid's Scorpid Sting is off
Sniper Shot on cooldown while mana >= 15 x seconds left
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 Agility and 14 crit rating, and 415 ranged attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown

Trueshot Aura's top rank gives 100 ranged attack power and Hunter's Mark's 140 (assumption hunter_tsa_hm_rank, user ruling 2026-10-15: Blizzard fixes both onto the curve; the client has 50 and 71, below the older ranks' 75 and 98)
Aspect of the Hawk held at rank 5 (90 RAP) since Forever's rank 6 gives only 55
Arcane Shot takes 10% of ranged attack power and Serpent Sting 3% a tick (the forever-hunter wiki; the beta log fit was 11% / 3.5%)
Auto Shot fires through casts with no 0.5 sec aim (open assumption)
Wildstalker Armor 4P/5P not in the preset (2P only); with them this build would gain +17 (measured on the 2026-10-12 gear)
Rapid Killing's +20% after a kill is never exercised on a single boss
22% more crit per Agility than Classic (assumption hunter_crit_per_agi, user ruling 2026-10-15: the beta's level 1 ratio carried to 60)

The ranged weapon is a 2.5 sec bow at Rhok'delar's 44.0 DPS (Striker's Mark's speed and spread, standards 22 Ranged). A 2.6 sec gun sims 0.3 to 1.0 higher with a 15% ammo pouch, but 3.4 to 5.2 lower with Era Phase 1's sure 14% pouch (Ribbly's Bandolier), and the 15% quiver only takes arrows

Scorpid Sting duty (standards 23): the request switches the raid's Scorpid Sting off and the hunter keeps its own up in place of Serpent Sting; it costs 98.0 / 96.3 / 78.4 DPS at 120 / 180 / 300 s against hunter__lone-wolf, most of it Serpent Sting's damage
The sting only lowers the boss's hit (2%, the slot it shares with Insect Swarm, whose raid debuff stays on), so it adds nothing to the raid's damage
notes: Request is hunter__lone-wolf's with the rotation swapped for ui/hunter/apls/lw_scorpid.apl.json (tools/rotopt/hunter_presets.sh) and debuffs.scorpidSting removed; mksettings writes the same raid as spec hunter_lw_scorpid. Request written by mksettings (spec hunter_lw) unchanged; it matches the shipped preset's gear, talents, APL, race, consumes, raid buffs, debuffs and professions. Pet set to none (petType omitted = PetNone).
